as_told.title: Jack Parsons, the OTO and sex magic rituals

plain: In the 1940s the rocket engineer Jack Parsons, whom Michels calls the American counterpart of the German rocket engineer Wernher von Braun, is said to have performed sex magic rituals in the California desert, following the occultist Aleister Crowley, together with L. Ron Hubbard, the founder of Scientology. Michels tells it himself in two episodes and calls it "historical fact". In one he adds that both men belonged to a Pasadena occult group he calls the OTO.
